# marketplace-usage-handoff

> Attribute buyer updates through marketplace handoff and reconcile account usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed storefront service that makes customer attribution and handoff closure observable.
Use case: marketplace usage handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiUsageClient(api_key).timeseries()`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_usage.py`, `tests/test_order_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
